Givers.Name: Mara Solane
Givers.Greeting: Jobs for people who don't faint at blood. The pay is honest. The hours are not.

Quests.Title: Medicine Run
Quests.Summary: The clinic's cold box is stranded at the Dust Devil Trailer Park, out past the western beltway, and the Neon Jackals have smelled the blood bags. Drive it home before the medicine spoils.
Quests.Done: The cold box made it to the clinic still cold. Mara called you a beautiful, reckless man, and meant about half of it.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Our supplier broke down at the Dust Devil Trailer Park. The cold box is still in his truck, and there are jackals sniffing at it.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Once you pick it up, the insulin has about five minutes. Drive like you mean it.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: I always drive like I mean it.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: You drive like you're being chased. It's not the same thing.

Steps.Objective: Drive to the Dust Devil Trailer Park in the western Badlands.
Drive off the Neon Jackals circling the truck.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to take the cold box
Steps.Objective: Grab the cold box from the truck.
Steps.Text: The cold box is still humming. Good.

Steps.Objective: Rush the medicine back to Mara's clinic in Sunken Row.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Still cold. You beautiful, reckless man. Get it inside.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Next time I'll send you for something that doesn't spoil. Like bandages. Or patience.

FailIf.Message: The cold box warmed up. The medicine is ruined.

Quests.Title: Outbreak at the Clinic
Quests.Summary: A tear in the Veil has opened by the canal, and Hollows are pouring toward the brightest lights on the street, which happen to be Mara's clinic. Hold the door, then close the tear.
Quests.Done: You held the clinic and sealed the tear by the canal. Old Mrs. Varga slept through all of it.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Something's wrong. The patients are all dreaming the same dream, and the lights keep flickering violet.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Malik. Behind you. Through the window.

Steps.Name: Patient
Steps.Objective: Hold the clinic. Keep the patients alive.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: They're coming from the canal. There's a tear down there, I can feel it in my teeth.

Steps.Objective: Close the tear by the Rust Canal Boathouse.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Everyone's alive. Old Mrs. Varga slept through the whole thing. She wants to know who was shouting.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Tell her it was the television.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: We don't have a television.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Then tell her it was me.

Quests.Title: The Night Patient
Quests.Summary: A young Static Saint with a Hollow bite is fading fast at the tavern in Grave Frequency, and the shades can smell it on him. Walk him through the dark to the Mender van on Signal Hill before the dead frequencies take him.
Quests.Done: Ezra Pell reached the Mender van on Signal Hill, still a boy and still complaining.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: There's a boy at the Static Saints Tavern with a Hollow bite. If he's not on my van by midnight, he won't be a boy anymore.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: The van is waiting by the Sundial on Signal Hill. Walk him. Engines get the shades excited.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Everything gets the shades excited.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Then be boring. For once.

Steps.Objective: Go to the Static Saints Tavern, and leave the car at the curb.

Steps.Name: Ezra Pell
Steps.Objective: Walk Ezra Pell to the Mender van on Signal Hill.

Lines.Speaker: Ezra Pell
Lines.Text: You're the bearer? Great. I'm bleeding on a legend.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Keep walking. Legends hate stopping.

Lines.Speaker: Brother Oslo
Lines.Text: Is that him? Lay him down. Gently. He's not luggage.

Lines.Speaker: Ezra Pell
Lines.Text: I feel like luggage.

Lines.Speaker: Brother Oslo
Lines.Text: Then you're the luckiest luggage on Signal Hill. Mara says thank you, bearer. She says it rolling her eyes, but she says it.

FailIf.Message: The engine woke every shade in Grave Frequency. Ezra didn't make it.

Quests.Title: Heart of Sand
Quests.Summary: Mara's best remedy for Hollow bites needs the glowing core of a Sand Golem, and an old prospector at the Starlite Motel swears one sleeps in the dunes behind the sign. Wake it, break it, and carry its heart home.
Quests.Done: You carried a Sand Golem's core home to Mara. It will close a hundred Hollow bites, and she said thank you without rolling her eyes.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Hollow bites close faster with sand core powder. Don't ask how we found that out.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: How did you find that out?

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: I said don't ask. There's a prospector at the Starlite Motel who talks to the golems. Start with her.

Steps.Name: Hattie Dunn
Steps.Objective: Find Hattie Dunn at the Starlite Motel.

Lines.Speaker: Hattie Dunn
Lines.Text: Mara's hunter, huh? The golem sleeps under the third dune past the sign. Leave it a cup of water and it sleeps forever.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: And if I don't?

Lines.Speaker: Hattie Dunn
Lines.Text: Then it wakes up thirsty. Don't say I didn't warn you. I warn everybody. Nobody listens. It's my hobby.

Steps.Objective: Find the third dune past the motel sign.

Steps.Name: The Dune Sleeper
Steps.Objective: Break the Dune Sleeper. Frost turns it to mud.
Dig the glowing core out of the sand.
Bring the sand core to Mara.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: It's still warm. It's still glowing. It's still a little bit angry.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: This will close a hundred Hollow bites. Maybe more. Thank you, Malik. Truly.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Did you just say thank you without rolling your eyes?

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Don't get used to it.
